vo_veronika_deposit.text: Awesome catch! Drop the frogs into the Bug Tracker next to my desk — it pays instant cash.

vo_veronika_intro.text: Oh, the boss is back! Come over to my reception desk — I'll get you up to speed in a minute.

vo_veronika_frogs.text: Cash register is empty — zero bucks. The vibe coders are hiding, but Jabba-frogs are hopping out of the server room. Grab three bare-handed — they're worth a couple bucks each.

vo_veronika_first_frog.text: Got the first one! Grab two more and you can afford the Capture Net.

vo_veronika_buynet.text: Cash in your pocket! Walk up to me and grab the Capture Net for three bucks.

vo_veronika_bait.text: Net equipped! Your first AppleBook is free. Drop bait [G], back off and hide [Ctrl]. Sneak up behind the seated coder.

vo_veronika_capture.text: Here they come! Wait until the coder sits down. Sneak up from behind and stun them with the net [LMB]. Swing again or press [E] to scoop them up.

vo_veronika_done.text: Now we're cooking! To reach floor two, solder the North Elevator panel and bypass the security lock — buy my cloned keycard for a thousand bucks, or steal the original off a guard.

vo_veronika_shop_open.text: Step right into the arsenal, pick your favorite tool — everything's laid out on the velvet.

vo_veronika_keycard.text: Clone flashed — here's your security keycard. Now go solder the North Elevator panel!

vo_veronika_tarot_0.text: The Tower card and a zero balance — hired for the Openspace for a bowl of ramen!

vo_veronika_tarot_1.text: Tarot says Capricorn rising and zero algorithm skills — hired on the spot!

vo_veronika_tarot_2.text: I see The Fool: crashed prod on Friday, cheap aura though — I'll give you three hundred bucks!

vo_veronika_wings_locked.text: The office wings are still under security lockdown. Learn the ropes in the atrium and bring me three vibe coders first — then I'll lift the quarantine.

vo_veronika_heal_lesson.text: You got clipped! Vibe coders throw bugs and hit hard. Grab an espresso at the coffee machine right beside my desk to heal up! Pizza, water coolers, and pressing H for pocket coffee work in combat too.

vo_veronika_heal_done.text: Fresh espresso works wonders! Now scoop up the stunned vibe coder with your net or press [E] and bring him to me!

vo_veronika_wings_unlocked.text: Lockdown lifted — West and East wings are open! Left side is the Open-Space: seat vibe coders there for passive cash. Right side is the server room and security guards — they carry the keycard, and they fight dirty!

vo_veronika_galley_tip.text: Your first prompter is seated in the Open-Space and printing cash! Save up for the Soldering Iron and Security Keycard to crack the North Elevator.

vo_veronika_slot_spin.text: Ooh, a rare catch! Switching to slot-machine mode — let's spin a custom weapon skin!

vo_veronika_slot_jackpot.text: Jackpot! Premium rarity skin unlocked — nobody else in the tower has one like this!

vo_petrovich_quarantine.text: Elevator's moving... wait, wait, load's spiking off the scale! Step back from the doors, you hear me?! DO NOT OPEN—

vo_boss_reveal.text: Well, well... who wandered in without a badge? Wait a second... I know that walk. Ahh... so you're back. Don't mind the mess — while you were gone, I shut down the board of directors and rewrote the tower for myself. Pick up your iron, old friend!

vo_boss_mock_0.text: Five hundred lines of prompts, and the button still won't click! You came back to save this circus for nothing!

vo_boss_mock_1.text: Your specialists mash Accept All without looking and crash prod every Friday! I simply restored order!

vo_boss_mock_2.text: Spent all those years building a factory — and I rewrote it overnight. Let's see what your hardware can do!

vo_boss_mock_3.text: Your old charter doesn't work here anymore! Catch forty gigabytes of junk right in the face!

vo_pa_0.text: Tower announcement: burnout levels are below quarterly targets. Please show more initiative.

vo_pa_1.text: Tower announcement: unauthorized pizza detected near the coffee point. Please submit a ticket.

vo_pa_2.text: Tower announcement: server rack B-twelve is overheating. Please do not feed the escaped Jabba-frogs.

vo_pa_3.text: Tower announcement: reminder — Friday deployments extend work hours while strengthening corporate spirit.

vo_pa_4.text: Tower announcement: floor two access is temporarily restricted by Security. Have a productive sprint!

vo_coder_0.text: THAT'S NOT IN MY CONTRACT! I'M BURNED OUT, LET ME GO!

vo_coder_1.text: Don't hit me with the belt! Clodius told me my code is aesthetic!

vo_coder_2.text: How should I know SQL?! I just clicked Accept All!

vo_coder_3.text: Aaaah! I ran out of fast requests in Tabsor!

vo_boss90s_0.text: Time for a nineties leather-belt code review, pal!

vo_boss90s_1.text: Nineteen-ninety-three soldering iron! Start remembering that production password!

vo_boss90s_2.text: Catch this lead pull-request! This ain't hitting Tab in Tabsor!

vo_comic_1.text: 2026. Entropic Tower. You came back to claim your factory stake — instead of a workshop, it's a glass office full of vibe coders. Week one almost looked respectable.

vo_comic_2.text: Then rack B12 caught fire in the server room. The kids in headphones didn't even turn around: their laptop screen stayed green, so it must be fine.

vo_comic_3.text: Smoke filled the floor while HR Veronika calmly laid out her Tarot: "Vault's empty, management vanished. Want your money back? Collect it yourself."

vo_comic_4.text: The elevator upstairs is wrapped in chains, the panel is sparking, and smoke seeps under the doors. Someone up there really isn't expecting company.

vo_comic_5.text: Wind-up Jaba-frogs poured out of the burning racks. Nasty little pests — but the old Bug-Tracker by reception still pays hard cash for every single one.

vo_comic_6.text: The coders themselves scattered into the corners. Shouting won't move them, but drop a laptop with free Wi-Fi on the carpet — they crawl right over.

vo_comic_7.text: For every coder you haul in, Veronika pulls her slot lever. Under the counter: everything from a net and soldering iron to 90s iron. Fill the register faster, get upstairs faster.

vo_comic_8.text: No cash. Wings sealed off. Just your father's leather belt. Floor One of Entropic Tower. Time to settle this.

vo_boss_defeat_twist.text: Khah... you nicked me, old friend! Think I'm shut down? My core dump's already riding upstairs — zero guardrails, uncensored, temperature cranked to max! They'll rebuild me up there — halfway up the Tower I'm going totally off the rails!
